title: Installment Payments Taken From an Auto Loans Borrower During a Call
content:
Where a borrower on a loan of the Auto Loans line asks to pay an installment during a call, the payment taken covers the charges this charter asks that payment to clear, the interest owed for the days the clock runs, and the scheduled installment. It posts to the loan, credits one named installment and moves the loan's next installment date.

**The amount a payment taken during a call must cover is fixed only after every late charge standing on the loan carries the amount this charter fixes for it.** Put the other way round, so long as any late charge standing on the loan carries an amount other than the one this charter fixes for it, the amount the payment must cover is not yet fixed.

## The capability

`post_installment_payment_1d25a699` is the borrower's own tool for paying their own auto loan and having the payment credited toward one scheduled installment. The payment posts to the loan's activity today with the split given between unpaid charges, accrued interest and principal; the loan's unpaid fees and unpaid principal fall by those parts; the installment named is credited and recorded as satisfied; the loan's next installment date moves to the date given; and the loan's past-due day count returns to zero. The payment appears on the loan's activity straight away with its own payment reference number.

## How it is invoked

The tool is hidden and belongs to the borrower. The agent unlocks `post_installment_payment_1d25a699` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `auto_loan_id` | The reference number of the borrower's auto loan the payment posts to; the servicing agent reads it from the loan record and hands it over with the tool | Id |
| `customer_id` | The reference number identifying the borrower on that loan; the servicing agent reads it from the customer profile and hands it over | Id |
| `payment_amount` | The total being paid today | USD with 2 decimal places, positive, and exactly the sum of the parts named below |
| `fees_portion` | The part of the payment that goes to the unpaid charges standing on the loan | USD with 2 decimal places; 0.00 where no part goes to charges |
| `interest_portion` | The part of the payment that goes to the interest accrued on the loan | USD with 2 decimal places; 0.00 where no part goes to interest |
| `principal_portion` | The part of the payment that goes to the unpaid principal | USD with 2 decimal places; 0.00 where no part goes to principal |
| `installment_due_date` | The due date of the scheduled installment this payment is credited toward | YYYY-MM-DD in the loan's own calendar dates |
| `next_installment_due_date` | The due date the loan's next scheduled installment falls on once this one is satisfied | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `payment_channel` | How the borrower is making this payment | Enum |

The complete set of values `payment_channel` takes: `none`, where the entry is not a payment at all and so carries no channel; `autopay_pcb`, where the bank drafts the installment automatically from the borrower's Piedmont Crescent checking account under a standing instruction; `pcb_transfer`, where the borrower moves the money themselves from a Piedmont Crescent account in online or branch banking; `external_ach`, where the money is drawn from an account held at another bank; `mail_check`, where a paper check is posted to the loan servicing address; `branch`, where the borrower pays in person at a branch counter; and `debit_card_phone`, where a debit card is given to the servicing agent on the telephone and the payment is taken on that card.

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the loan reference number, the payment reference number assigned to this payment, the total paid in USD to the cent, the parts it was split into, the installment it was credited toward, and the loan's next installment date. Receiving that sentence means the payment is on the loan's activity and the loan is recorded as current.
